fact: In an interview of 2 October 2024 the CNDP president said CNDP strengthens controls and refers non-compliant controllers to the competent prosecutor, that disciplinary procedures against TLS Contact, VFS GCC and BLSMOR were still open, and that a new law was hoped to reach Parliament by 2025 at the latest.
title: Omar Seghrouchi (CNDP) : "L'investissement n'absout pas les violations des données personnelles"
